exposure: women with GDM and a macrosomic baby
cohort: Women who gave birth vaginally in NSW, from 2007 to 2013
finding: Women with GDM and a macrosomic baby (birthweight ≥ 4000 g) had a higher risk of OASIs with forceps or vacuum, compared with those without GDM.
mod_finding: For primiparous women with GDM and all women without GDM, an episiotomy with forceps was associated with lower odds of OASIs than forceps only.
